summary.en-US: R&D remains a research candidate. Historical execution and input audits expose unresolved gaps; the corrected signal screen and older historical extension remain separate.
summary.zh-CN: 研发仍是研究候选。历史执行与输入审计发现未解决的缺口；修正后的信号筛查与更早的历史扩展保持分开。

label.en-US: Historical execution, input and accounting follow-up
label.zh-CN: 历史执行、输入与会计口径后续核验

question.en-US: Does R&D intensity carry independent information?
question.zh-CN: 研发强度是否包含独立信息？

finding.en-US: The early raw ratio and small-cap comparator were both positive, while R&D/revenue was near zero.
finding.zh-CN: 早期原始比例与小市值对照均为正，研发/收入接近零。

decision.en-US: Treat denominator exposure as a competing explanation, not pure innovation alpha.
decision.zh-CN: 将分母暴露视为竞争解释，不直接称为纯创新 Alpha。

question.zh-CN: 不同研发定义是否方向一致？

finding.en-US: The corrected run has 77 monthly sections at 20 sessions and 66 at 220; the full residual is weaker than market-cap-scaled variants.
finding.zh-CN: 修正回放有 77 个 20 日截面和 66 个 220 日截面；完整残差弱于市值缩放变体。

decision.en-US: Use horizon-specific counts; do not splice the earlier annual extension into this replay.
decision.zh-CN: 分别报告期限样本数，不将早期年度扩展拼入本次回放。

title.en-US: Audit costs and seal prospective evidence
title.zh-CN: 审计成本并封存前瞻证据

question.en-US: Can exploratory labels become executable evidence?
question.zh-CN: 探索性标签能否升级为可执行证据？

finding.en-US: Cost and denominator diagnostics exist; the historical correction chain and long-horizon label maturity remain open.
finding.zh-CN: 已有成本与分母诊断；历史更正链和长期标签成熟仍未完成。

decision.en-US: Keep the October 2026–September 2027 holdout sealed until all labels mature and gates pass.
decision.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月至 2027 年 9 月留出需等全部标签成熟并通过门禁后解封。

title.en-US: Check accounting definitions across filing samples
title.zh-CN: 跨年报样本核对会计定义

question.en-US: Does a common currency imply the same R&D measure?
question.zh-CN: 币种一致是否代表研发口径一致？

finding.en-US: Ten purposive issuer/year comparisons cover four issuers and five report years. Total investment and expensed R&D differ; one later comparative value disagrees with the archived field.
finding.zh-CN: 十个定向公司/年度比较覆盖四家公司、五个报告年度。投入合计与费用化研发不同；一处后续比较值与归档字段不一致。

decision.en-US: Keep annual total investment separate from expense TTM; do not certify universe-wide units from samples.
decision.zh-CN: 年度投入合计与费用 TTM 分开，不从抽样推断全市场口径已通过。

title.zh-CN: 拆分失败原因与集中度

question.en-US: Are a few anomalous securities blocking the historical deciles?
question.zh-CN: 历史十分组是否仅被少数异常证券阻断？

finding.en-US: There are 10,825 deduplicated endpoint failure events across 3,894 securities; no factor/decile series passes every endpoint.
finding.zh-CN: 端点失败去重后有 10,825 个事件，涉及 3,894 只证券；没有因子/分组序列通过全部端点检查。

decision.en-US: Use persistent holdings diagnostics and retain unresolved gaps; the holdout remains sealed.
decision.zh-CN: 继续用保留持仓的诊断处理缺口；前瞻留出仍封存。

title.en-US: Audit inputs and compare identical samples
title.zh-CN: 审计输入并比较相同样本

question.en-US: Does the numerator explain the same association as valuation?
question.zh-CN: 研发分子能否解释与估值相同的关联？

finding.en-US: Independent industry mapping agrees with the archived panel. On matched rows, inverse size and value associations exceed log R&D; this does not establish a causal return source.
finding.zh-CN: 独立行业映射与归档面板一致。同样本中，逆规模与估值关联高于对数研发金额；这不能证明收益的因果来源。

decision.en-US: Keep conditional coverage separate from PIT qualification, and association separate from portfolio validation.
decision.zh-CN: 条件覆盖率与 PIT 资格分开，相关性与组合验证分开。

context.en-US: 20-session: 77 sections; 220-session: 66 sections. Overlapping labels; no costed portfolio return.
context.zh-CN: 20 日 77 个截面，220 日 66 个截面。标签重叠；不是成本后组合收益。

interpretation.en-US: The market-cap denominator matters; stronger long-horizon IC does not prove independent tradable alpha.
interpretation.zh-CN: 市值分母作用明显；长期 IC 较高并不能证明独立、可交易的 Alpha。

categories.en-US: Five-year decayed R&D stock / market cap
categories.zh-CN: 五年衰减研发资本 / 市值

metric.zh-CN: 被标记的组合持仓端点 / 已检查端点

context.en-US: Separate reconstructed historical extension, 2019–2026 (partial first/last years). Securities repeat across portfolios. Closing limits are proxies, not actual fills; reasons can overlap.
context.zh-CN: 独立的历史重建扩展，2019–2026 年（首尾年份不完整）。同一证券可出现在多个组合中。收盘涨跌停是代理检查，不代表真实成交；失败原因可重叠。

interpretation.en-US: Failure is not confined to a few names: 10,825 unique security/date/side/reason events across 3,894 securities; the top ten account for 1.10%. Missing suspension quotes do not prove an absence of suspensions.
interpretation.zh-CN: 失败并非集中于少数名字：证券/日期/方向/原因去重后有 10,825 个事件，涉及 3,894 只证券，前十只占 1.10%。停牌日缺少行情不代表没有停牌。

label.zh-CN: 买入端收盘涨跌停代理
卖出端收盘涨跌停代理

title.zh-CN: 行业与控制变量的条件覆盖率

metric.en-US: Covered rows / retained historical panel rows
metric.zh-CN: 覆盖行数 / 已保留历史面板行数

context.en-US: Separate historical extension, 2019–2026. Denominator: already filtered panel, not all-market eligibility. The industry interval join was independently recomputed; publication times remain unverified.
context.zh-CN: 独立的历史扩展，2019–2026 年。分母是已筛选面板，不是全市场合格股票。独立重算了行业区间匹配，但历史公布时点尚未验证。

interpretation.en-US: High retained-row coverage and zero mapping disagreements do not prove historical information availability. Early thin years are not plotted as broad coverage.
interpretation.zh-CN: 保留样本中的高覆盖率、映射零差异不等于历史时点可得性已被证明。早期稀疏年份不作为广泛覆盖绘图。

title.zh-CN: 同样本研发分子与估值分母对照

metric.en-US: Mean monthly Rank IC on identical names within each horizon
metric.zh-CN: 各期限内相同证券样本的月度平均 Rank IC

context.en-US: Separate reconstructed historical extension: 90 mature 20-session and 80 mature 220-session sections through 2026-09-30. All six components use the same complete rows per date. Not the corrected current replay, not portfolio returns.
context.zh-CN: 独立的历史扩展：截至 2026-09-30，20 日有 90 个成熟截面，220 日有 80 个。每个日期六项对照使用相同完整样本。不属于当前修正回放，也不是组合收益。

interpretation.en-US: Inverse size and value have stronger univariate associations than the R&D numerator. Prior joint regressions give different conditional slopes, so these correlations cannot establish causal attribution.
interpretation.zh-CN: 逆规模与估值的单变量关联强于研发分子。此前联合回归的条件系数方向不同，因此这些相关性不能证明因果归因。

next_question.en-US: Explicit full-day suspension evidence advances all 60 replay failure dates, but later unresolved marks remain; ten growth portfolios also have incomplete formations. Identity and terminal-event recovery, formal portfolio validation, and revision gates remain open.
next_question.zh-CN: 明确的全天停牌证据让 60 条回放的失败日期全部后移，但后续仍有未解释的价格缺口；另有十条研发增长组合建仓不完整。证券身份与退市事件恢复、正式组合验证及修订门槛仍未完成。

before.en-US: Raw R&D/market-cap correlation could be read as an R&D premium.
before.zh-CN: 原始研发/市值相关性可能被解释为研发溢价。

trigger.en-US: Style controls and alternate scales weaken the signal.
trigger.zh-CN: 风格控制与替代尺度使信号减弱。

after.en-US: Retain an exploratory valuation-linked signal; independence is unresolved.
after.zh-CN: 保留探索性估值相关信号，独立性未解决。

before.en-US: A frozen protocol could appear ready to evaluate immediately.
before.zh-CN: 冻结协议可能看起来可以立即评估。

trigger.en-US: The prospective window and long labels have not matured.
trigger.zh-CN: 前瞻窗口与长期标签尚未成熟。

after.en-US: The holdout remains sealed; no performance reading is authorized by this display.
after.zh-CN: 留出仍封存；本次呈现不赋予读取表现的资格。
